checks.name: Unpacked MV3 loads with registered capture command
Ordinary page keyboard input is a negative control for browser command routing
Real hotkey captures original page, selection, visible text, and time without focus or notification
Manual note remains paired to pre-tab-change context and persists after reload
Resume restores local context and next step with no task execution
Missing local resume ID is explicit and cannot attach to another context
Saved meeting time triggers a real chrome.alarms notification
Meeting join URL, absence boundaries, return/end persist; unavailable speech cannot fake Takeover
Local mode has zero observed worker HTTP requests, with positive network instrumentation control
Enabling sync does not enqueue private history; local mode denies batch approval
Real IndexedDB multi-write failure rejects and rolls back prior writes
Restricted browser page records explicit unavailable page text
Full browser restart retains notes, tasks, meeting state, and absence boundaries
